description.en: Posted on new topics in this node, in your own words. Markdown works. {username} becomes the author's name.
description.zh_CN: 发在本节点的新主题下，用你自己的话写。支持 Markdown。{username} 会替换成发帖人的用户名。

description.en: "newcomers" says it once to each person, the first time they open a topic here. "everyone" says it on every topic — nobody can say they were not told, at the cost of regulars learning to scroll past it.
description.zh_CN: 「newcomers」对每个人只说一次，在他们第一次在这里发主题时。「everyone」每个主题都说——谁都不能说没被告知，代价是老用户会学会直接划过去。

description.en: Pins the notice so it stays above the replies. Needs this app installed in a node, not site-wide.
description.zh_CN: 把公告置顶，使其始终在回复上方。需要本应用装在某个节点上，而不是全站。

description.en: Do not post the notice under topics opened by staff. They wrote the rules.
description.zh_CN: 不在管理人员发的主题下发公告——规则就是他们写的。
